btcmaxis.name: bitcoin maxis
btcmaxis.tldr: the only sound money; everything else is noise
btcmaxis.ontology: Sound money is the base layer of civilization; Bitcoin is the only credibly neutral monetary substrate — everything else on this map is fiat, noise, or a scam.

ethereum.name: ethereum
ethereum.tldr: credibly neutral protocols; the world computer
ethereum.ontology: Reality is programmable coordination; credibly neutral protocols are how humanity scales trust. The world computer settles everything else on this map eventually.

solana.name: solana
solana.tldr: one global state machine, as fast as light allows
solana.ontology: Speed is the feature and the market is the test; one global state machine, block by 400-millisecond block. Increase bandwidth, reduce latency.

stablecoins.name: the stablecoin economy
stablecoins.tldr: the dollar won crypto; crypto won the dollar's rails
stablecoins.ontology: The dollar won crypto and crypto won the dollar's rails; the stablecoin is the internet's checking account, and regulation is the moat.

rwa.name: tokenized tradfi
rwa.ontology: Every asset — treasuries, gold, credit, houses — migrates on-chain eventually; the blockchain is the back office of the next financial system.

exchangetokens.name: the exchange empires
exchangetokens.tldr: the casino always wins; own the house
exchangetokens.ontology: Flow is the moat and the listing is the favor; whatever the cycle does, the house collects the fee. Own the house.

xrparmy.name: the xrp army
xrparmy.ontology: The banks will settle on our rails and the lawsuit was proof of importance; patience is the strategy and the standard is coming.

oldguard.name: the old guard L1s
oldguard.tldr: the tech was never the problem
oldguard.ontology: The roadmaps were right, the peer review was real, and the market is a popularity contest; the tech was never the problem. Ecosystems outlive cycles.

privacy.name: privacy coins
privacy.tldr: cash was private; money should be again
privacy.ontology: Financial privacy is a human right, surveillance is the default, and the only cash left is the kind they cannot see. The original cypherpunk errand.

l2s.name: the L2 archipelago
l2s.ontology: Blockspace scales in layers: inherit Ethereum's security, compress the cost, and the rollup becomes the city where people actually live.

linkmarines.name: the link marines
linkmarines.tldr: the oracle is the truth layer
linkmarines.ontology: Smart contracts are blind without oracles; whoever feeds the chain the world's data is the truth layer of everything built on it.

newl1s.name: the new L1 frontier
newl1s.tldr: the next chain will be the fast one
newl1s.ontology: Every cycle mints a new fastest chain and a new believer class; throughput is destiny and migration is always one killer app away.

aicoins.name: the AI coins
aicoins.ontology: Intelligence is becoming the world's largest market and it must not be owned by five companies; tokens are how compute, models, and identity stay open.

defi.name: defi
defi.ontology: Finance is being rebuilt as open programmable infrastructure; lending, trading, and yield without permission — the protocols outlive their founders.

memecoins.name: the trenches
memecoins.ontology: Attention is the only real asset and price is the only truth; the coin is the community and the sin is not playing but exiting late.

degenperps.name: the perp casinos
degenperps.ontology: The market is a 24/7 casino and the only honest venue is one that cannot close; leverage is a right and the funding rate is the weather.

fiat.name: the fiat ocean
fiat.tldr: the water every coin defines itself against
fiat.ontology: State money — not an island but the water: the unit of account, the exit everyone prices in, the default every tribe on this map defines itself against. It doesn't feel like a system for the same reason water doesn't feel wet.
